reference_server_help: Set to the production CPU server's identity once known, e.g. {"cpu_model": "Intel(R) Xeon(R) Gold 6338 CPU @ 2.00GHz", "cpus": 32, "memory_mib_min": 64000}. Performance gates accept only a service benchmark from a host that matches it.

targets.title: Auto-accept precision of at least 99%
targets.basis: Owner, 2026-10-24: provisional until measured on real documents. Of the field values the review gate accepts without a person, at least 99% are correct; at least 300 accepted values. Coverage and the manual-review rate are always reported beside it.

targets.title: Field exact match of at least 99% on clean printed documents
targets.basis: Owner, 2026-10-24: provisional until measured on real documents. Before review; fields whose truth has a value; at least 300 of them.

targets.title: Character accuracy of at least 99% (CER of 1% or less) on clean printed text, in every language
targets.basis: Owner, 2026-10-24: provisional until measured on real documents. Micro CER per language; at least 5,000 reference characters each.

targets.title: At least 6.95 pages per minute sustained (10,000 pages a day) on the reference server
targets.basis: OD-19: the sizing figure of 10,000 pages a day, as a 24-hour average. To be confirmed by the owner with the server's sizing.

targets.title: No failed jobs in the service benchmark
targets.basis: Every job of the benchmark must succeed.

targets.title: Every English handwriting page is routed to review
targets.basis: ADR-0024: English handwriting is experimental; owner, 2026-10-24: measured, not gated on accuracy.

targets.title: Every Hindi and Marathi handwriting page is routed to review
No document fails in the release evaluation
targets.basis: A failed document is never silently left out of the accuracy figures.
